[b][/b]We’re so close to the finish line! Well done for making it this far!

In Python, a comment is created by inserting an [b]octothorpe[/b] (otherwise known as a number sign or hash symbol: #). All text after it on that line is ignored.
[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="3947"]x = 365

[b]# print (x // y)[/b]
[b]# another comment[/b][/code]
[note]Unlike programming languages such as C, Python doesn’t have general-purpose multiline comments.[/note]

**注释** 是对代码的注释，用于使其更容易理解。它们并不影响代码的运行。

在Python中，注释是通过插入一个 **#** 来表示的。该行中它之后的所有文本都被忽略。

代码如下：

resolved.title: 文档
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Docstrings[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

[b][/b]Ok let’s wrap up module 6 with docstrings.

[b]Docstrings [/b](documentation strings) are similar to comments, in that they’re designed to explain code. But! they’re more specific and have a different syntax. 

They’re created by putting a multiline string containing an explanation of the function below the [b]function's first line[/b]. Like this:[code format="py" codeId="3948"]def shout(word):
  [b]"""
  Print a word with an
  exclamation mark following it.
  """[/b]
  print(word + "!")
    
shout("spam")[/code]
[note]Unlike conventional comments, [b]docstrings [/b]are retained throughout the runtime of the program. This allows the programmer to inspect these comments at run time.[/note]

content.text:
本节课我们学习 **文档串** 。

**docstrings**（文档字符串）类似于注释，因为它们是用来解释代码的。但是！它们更具体，而且有不同的语法。

它们是通过在 **函数** 的第一行下面放置一个包含函数解释的多行字符串来创建的。

代码如下：
content.text_html:
Ok let’s wrap up module 6 with docstrings.

**Docstrings **(documentation strings) are similar to comments, in that they’re designed to explain code. But! they’re more specific and have a different syntax.

They’re created by putting a multiline string containing an explanation of the function below the function's first line. Like this:

好了，让我们用文档串来总结一下模块6。

**docstrings **（文档字符串）类似于注释，因为它们是用来解释代码的。但是！它们更具体，而且有不同的语法。

它们是通过在**函数的第一行下面放置一个包含函数解释的多行字符串来创建的。像这样。

content.content:
def shout(word):
    """
    为下面的代码写一些解释。
    """
    print(word + "!")

shout("spam")
